jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Bot Detection (Client-Side & Signals) - EMEA Remote
jobs.description:
At Hugging Face, we're on a journey to democratize good AI. We are building the fastest growing platform for AI builders with over 20 million users who collectively shared over 4 million models, 1 million datasets & 1.5 million apps. Our open-source libraries have more than 700,000 stars on Github.

About the Role

Hugging Face hosts millions of models, datasets and Spaces, and serves a very large community of developers. That scale also brings automated abuse: fake accounts, scraping, spam, credential stuffing, and bots gaming downloads, likes and trending signals. We're building a small, dedicated bot-detection effort inside our Trust & Safety team, and we're looking for an engineer to own the signal-collection side of it.

You'll design and ship the mechanisms that tell humans from automation across every surface where people and machines touch the Hub: web, API, git/LFS, CLI and client libraries. "Front" here is broad. It covers browser instrumentation, but also what we can learn from network, TLS and protocol behavior, and from how clients talk to our infrastructure.

What you'll do

  • Design, build and deploy detection signals in production: browser and device fingerprinting, client-side challenges, TLS/HTTP fingerprinting, behavioral telemetry
  • Analyze how real-world bots and automation frameworks work (headless browsers, anti-detect browsers, residential proxies, CAPTCHA farms) and build countermeasures that hold up when attackers adapt
  • Work with our data-focused bot-detection engineer to turn raw signals into reliable features and decisions
  • Respect user privacy and keep legitimate developers, researchers and API users free of friction
  • Partner with infra, security and Hub engineers to roll out mitigations (rate limiting, step-up challenges, enforcement) safely at scale
  • Contribute openly where it makes sense: tooling, write-ups and research shared with the community

Requirements

  • You have solid hands-on experience in bot detection, anti-fraud, browser fingerprinting, web security or a closely related field, and you've shipped things that ran in production
  • You understand browser internals and the web platform deeply (JavaScript, DOM and rendering APIs, WebGL/Canvas/Audio, extensions), as well as networking protocols (HTTP/2/3, TLS)
  • You know the attacker's toolbox from the inside (Puppeteer/Playwright/Selenium, stealth plugins, automation frameworks) and you like taking it apart
  • You're comfortable across the stack: TypeScript/JavaScript, and at least one backend language (Python, Go, Rust…)
  • You're pragmatic: you prefer a signal that works today and improves tomorrow over a perfect system that never ships
  • You care about privacy and about not punishing legitimate users

Nice to have

  • Published work or talks on fingerprinting, bot detection or web measurement (academic or industry). A research background is welcome as long as you like seeing your work in prod
  • Experience at a bot-management, anti-fraud or CDN/WAF company
  • Open-source contributions

One more thing

At Hugging Face we believe great AI shouldn't require a massive cluster, we build for everyone, especially the GPU-poor. And because we read every application, here's a small sign that you read this one too: start your answer to the first application question with the words “GPU-poor and proud 🤗”. No trick, no catch, it just tells us a real person is on the other side.

Benefits

More about Hugging Face

We are actively working to build a culture that values diversity, equity, and inclusivity. We are intentionally building a workplace where people feel respected and supported—regardless of who you are or where you come from. We believe this is foundational to building a great company and community. Hugging Face is an equal opportunity employer and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We value development. You will work with some of the smartest people in our industry. We are an organization that has a bias for impact and is always challenging ourselves to continuously grow. We provide all employees with reimbursement for relevant conferences, training, and education.

We care about your well-being. We offer flexible working hours and remote options. We offer health, dental, and vision benefits for employees and their dependents. We also offer parental leave and flexible paid time off.

We support our employees wherever they are. While we have office spaces in NYC and Paris, we're very distributed and all remote employees have the opportunity to visit our offices. If needed, we'll also outfit your workstation to ensure you succeed.

We want our teammates to be shareholders. All employees have company equity as part of their compensation package. If we succeed in becoming a category-defining platform in machine learning and artificial intelligence, everyone enjoys the upside.

We support the community. We believe major scientific advancements are the result of collaboration across the field. Join a community supporting the ML/AI community.

Whether you are looking to further develop your technical programming expertise, take on study lead responsibilities, or contribute at a Principal level, we offer opportunities aligned with your experience and career stage.


You can be 100% home-based in EMEA or work from our local office in your home country.

  • Performing quality control of SDTM, ADaM and TFL deliverables.

  • Producing submission documentation including Define-XML, Analysis Results Metadata (ARM), annotated CRFs and Reviewer’s Guides.

  • Strong knowledge of SAS® programming and CDISC standards, including SDTM and ADaM.

Experience:

We are interested in speaking with Statistical Programmers at different stages of their careers:

Statistical Programmer II

  • Typically 2+ years of SAS® programming experience within the CRO or pharmaceutical industry.
  • Knowledge of CDISC requirements.
  • Experience with SDTM, ADaM and TFL programming.

Senior Statistical Programmer

  • Typically 3–5 years of SAS® programming experience within the CRO or pharmaceutical industry.

  • Experience leading programming activities and mentoring less-experienced programmers is desirable.

Principal Statistical Programmer

  • Typically 6+ years of SAS® programming experience within the CRO or pharmaceutical industry.
  • Experience working as a Lead Statistical Programmer on complex clinical studies.
  • Broad understanding of clinical trials from study set-up through completion and of related functions such as Biostatistics and Clinical Data Management.

jobs.title: Professional Development Manager
jobs.description:
Professional Development Manager

This position is based on the African continent (with a strong preference for one of Enko Education’s 11 countries of operation).

Are you an experienced Learning & Development professional with a strong background in instructional design and digital learning tools? Do you thrive in dynamic, fast-paced, and scale-up environments and enjoy building practical, scalable learning ecosystems in a strategic and structured way? Then, you might want to carefully read through the following.

Enko Education is seeking a Professional Development Manager to own and scale our group-wide learning and development strategy across our growing network of international schools. You are an autonomous, hands-on, and tech-savvy L&D professional with a deep understanding of instructional design ("ingénierie de formation") and adult learning. Your expertise enables you to build high-impact training programs, manage digital learning platforms, and foster a strong peer-to-peer learning culture across the organization.

With 4+ years of experience in L&D, instructional design, or digital learning—ideally within a multi-country organization—you have a solid foundation in designing training modules from scratch and administering Learning Management Systems (LMS) or training tracking platforms.

This year, we laid the foundations of our learning ecosystem: an internal tracking platform for all staff training sessions, a nascent internal resource library, and a clear Instructional Design Framework ("Cahier des charges") for staff who design courses. Your ability to take full ownership of this ecosystem, grow our internal library without relying on costly external providers, and mobilize busy managers and internal facilitators across Africa will be key to your success in this role.

This is a unique chance to shape the professional growth of hundreds of educators and staff within a fast-growing education group in Africa. Are you ready to take on the challenge?

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the L&D Strategy: Define and lead the professional development roadmap for Enko Education, ensuring our training programs match the group's priorities.
  • Design Trainings & Uphold Standards: Create engaging training modules yourself, and use our internal design framework (Cahier des charges) to guide and coach internal facilitators so every training meets Enko Education’s quality standards.
  • Manage our Learning Platform: Run and optimize our internal tracking tool. Ensure smooth session registrations, attendance tracking, and clear reporting across all schools.
  • Grow our Internal Library: Expand and organize our internal resource library. Encourage staff across the group to record, share, and reuse internal content rather than buying external courses.
  • Mobilize Managers & Facilitators: Work closely with school leaders, managers, and internal trainers. Help managers keep their teams active on the platform and support facilitators in delivering great sessions.
  • Track Impact: Monitor training participation and library usage to share clear, simple insights with leadership.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a hands-on, autonomous manager who is just as comfortable designing a training module as managing a digital platform or convincing a school director to engage their team.

Your profile in 6 points:

  1. Strong Instructional Design Skills: Solid experience in instructional design (“ingénierie de formation”). You know how to build practical, engaging training from scratch.
  2. Tech-Savvy & LMS Experience: Comfortable with digital tools and experienced in managing an LMS or training tracking platform. You know how to use technology (and AI) to work smarter and faster.
  3. Resourceful Mindset: You like building things yourself rather than buying expensive off-the-shelf solutions. You know how to bring out the best expertise already inside a company.
  4. High Autonomy & Organization: You can take full ownership of your projects from day one, manage multiple stakeholders across different countries, and deliver results without heavy supervision.
  5. Strong Influence & People Skills: You know how to motivate busy managers and trainers across different cultures through collaboration, listening, and clear communication—not hierarchy.
  6. Bilingual (French & English):Full professional fluency in both English and French is mandatory to design content and work with all our teams across Africa.

Contract, Location, and Eligibility

  • Contract: Permanent employment (CDI) if based in one of our 11 countries of operation, or Independent Consulting / Freelance contract.
  • Location:Based on the African continent (strong preference for one of Enko Education's 11 countries of operation). Open to professionals in other locations planning to relocate to the continent.
  • Eligibility: Applicants must be legally authorized to work or operate as a consultant in their country of residence.

Why Join Us?

  • A Mission with purpose: Directly impact the educators and teams shaping the future of education in Africa.
  • Real ownership: Take the lead on a fresh learning ecosystem with the freedom to shape it and see the immediate impact of your work.
  • Agility over bureaucracy: We value results, pragmatism, and initiative in a flexible working environment.
  • A value-driven team: Join a passionate, pan-African team built on humility, action, and a deep commitment to our students' success.

Our Recruitment Process

  1. Culture Fit Interview: To get to know each other and assess mutual alignment between our mission and your aspirations
  2. Practical Case Study: A hands-on exercise focused on instructional design and driving adoption of our internal library.
  3. Focused Technical Interview: To discuss your L&D experience, LMS management, and how you work with stakeholders.
  4. Final Career Interview: To review your career path and make sure this role fits your ambitions.

Welcome to Enko!


(English version)

Equal Opportunities & Safer Recruitment

Enko Education is an equal opportunities employer, committed to inclusivity, diversity, and valuing difference. Enko Education schools are committed to child safeguarding and promoting the welfare of students and young people, and we expect all staff, volunteers, and third parties to share this commitment. Our safer recruitment practices aim to ensure that only individuals committed to child safeguarding join our schools. You can read our Safer Recruitment Statement here.

  • Successful candidates must provide a police clearance (or equivalent) from every country where they have lived in the past 10 years before signing an employment contract.
  • Reference checks with previous employers will also be conducted for each successful candidate.

About Enko Education

International education with Africa at heart and the world in mind.

Enko Education is a fast-growing network of 15 international schools in 10 African countries, offering international education with Africa at heart and the world in mind. Our mission is to make high-quality international education accessible to more African learners and to guide them towards the world’s best universities through innovative programmes leading to globally recognised qualifications.

Since 2014, Enko Education has helped thousands of students secure admission to top universities such as Yale College, Sciences Po, École Polytechnique, and the University of Toronto. Backed by leading development finance institutions and funds including Proparco, I&P, Adiwale, BIO Invest, Oiko Credit and Liquid Africa, we are on track to reach 20,000 students by 2028.

Learn more on our website.

Égalité des chances & Recrutement sécurisé

Enko Education est un employeur qui respecte l’égalité des chances, attaché à l’inclusion, à la diversité et à la valorisation des différences. Enko Education est un réseau en pleine croissance de 15 écoles internationales dans 10 pays d’Afrique, offrant une éducation internationale de qualité à un coût accessible. Reporting To: Principal, Credit and Risk

Department: Investment Management

Location: Remote, preference for candidates based in Europe, Caucasus, Central Asia, South Asia, Africa

Firm Overview

WaterEquity is an asset manager dedicated to directing private investments into the water and sanitation sector. We invest in financial institutions, enterprises, and infrastructure in emerging and frontier markets delivering safe water and sanitation solutions to low-income communities. WaterEquity is a subsidiary of Water.org, a non-profit organization dedicated to solving the global water crisis. Since its launch in 2016, WaterEquity has raised six funds with over $510M in committed capital to solve UN Sustainable Development Goal 6. WaterEquity LLC is a U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission-registered investment adviser. Learn more about us at .

Summary

WaterEquity is seeking a Vice President (VP) on the Credit and Risk Team to focus on a dual mandate of credit analysis and underwriting of investments plus risk management and portfolio monitoring. The role will partner closely with the global investment team to participate in the investment process, with a focus on term sheet and screening memo review, due diligence and investment memo drafting. The role will also assess, monitor and manage risk across WaterEquity’s investments, including drafting risk opinions for potential investments. Investments consist of lending to financial institutions that on-lend to households and enterprises for water and sanitation. WaterEquity also recently launched a new investment strategy focused on equity investments in water and sanitation projects and companies. The VP will primarily support on the financial institution lending portfolio. The VP, Credit and Risk will report to the Principal, Credit and Risk.

The ideal candidate brings 5–7+ years of experience in credit analysis, risk, portfolio management, and/or investment underwriting and is eager for opportunities to learn and grow. The role is an excellent opportunity for a mid-career professional with a passion for impact investing, an eye for detail, strong analytical skills, and who is comfortable with change. The ideal candidate thrives in a dynamic, entrepreneurial environment, excels at independent work and communication, and is able to manage multiple projects simultaneously. The candidate should be comfortable working remotely and with team members in diverse geographic locations. WaterEquity is a fully remote company. Candidate must already have the legal right to work in their country of residence.

Job Responsibilities

Risk management for the investment process

  • Review term sheets and screening memos
  • Lead pre-due diligence (DD) and post-DD meetings with deal team to confirm key questions, key findings and updates
  • Advise deal teams on financial covenants, risk mitigation measures, and transaction structuring
  • Draft succinct risk opinions that are part of the investment memo presented to the investment committee

Due diligence and analysis

  • Partner with investment team leads as a member of the deal team across geographies (in cases where VP is not assigned on the risk side)

  • Prepare investment documentation, including analysis on performance, key risks and mitigants, and stress tests
  • Present opportunities to the Investment Committee
  • Conduct financial analysis, including financial modeling, credit assessment and stress testing

Portfolio management

  • Analyze financial, operational, and impact data from investees to identify risks and understand trends
  • Communicate risks and recommend mitigation strategies across various stakeholders, including the investment team and investment committee
  • Identify financial changes, assess covenant violations among investees and propose strategies for resolution, including covenant waivers and amendments
  • Develop and update portfolio-level tools and reporting to assess portfolio trends, including related to quarterly fund reporting
  • Develop country risk tools, risk scoring models, and analytical frameworks
  • Perform scenario analysis and stress testing of risks to identify opportunities for improved portfolio management, asset allocation, and investment policies and processes
  • Help implement work-out strategies for underperforming or distressed investments
  • Support quarterly valuation processes for portfolio investments

Skills and Qualifications

  • Master’s degree (or equivalent work experience) in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, or a related field
  • 5–7+ years of relevant work experience in finance/banking/microfinance/impact investing in emerging markets, financial statement analysis, risk analysis, and/or portfolio management
  • Experience analyzing or monitoring debt and/or equity investments in emerging markets
  • Experience with due diligence and analysis of investment opportunities in financial institutions
  • Advanced Excel skills and an analytical, problem-solving mindset
  • Experience boiling down complex risk issues in succinct and concise written work products
  • Ability to manage financial data plus identify, troubleshoot, and resolve data issues
  • Willingness to travel up to approximately 30% to 40% of the time
  • Effective interpersonal and communication skills and experience in a remote working environment
  • Critical thinker with strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Fluency in English is required. Proficiency in foreign languages is an advantage.
  • Preference for:
    • Russian language proficiency
    • Investment management experience in Europe, the Caucasus, and/or Central Asia
    • Candidates based in Europe, the Caucasus, or Central Asia

Physical Requirements

This role involves extended periods of sitting and reaching. This role requires the ability to see, talk, and hear.

Compensation and Benefits

The individual who fills this position will be employed by an international employer of record and assigned full-time to WaterEquity. This position will offer full-time benefits, including medical, dental/vision (where applicable), and periodic review for merit and incentive pay based on organizational and personal achievement. All country-specific statutory requirements (i.e., time off) will apply. Overall compensation will be commensurate with education and experience and structured to reflect a competitive package for a full-time team member. No relocation benefits, work permit reimbursement, or visa sponsorship will be offered.

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

Compliance can determine whether a customer wins an enterprise deal, enters a new market, or meets an important security requirement. You will sell against these business outcomes—not simply a software feature lis

The kind of builder we're looking for -

Inclusion & Diversity -

jobs.description:
At Hugging Face, we're on a journey to democratize good AI. We are building the fastest growing platform for AI builders with over 20 million users who collectively shared over 4 million models, 1 million datasets & 1.5 million apps. Our open-source libraries have more than 700,000 stars on Github.

About the Role

Hugging Face hosts millions of models, datasets and Spaces, and serves a very large community of developers. With that scale comes automated abuse: fake accounts, scraping, spam, and bots gaming downloads, likes and trending signals. We're building a small, dedicated bot-detection effort inside our Trust & Safety team, and we're looking for an engineer to own the data and modeling side of it.

You'll turn large volumes of traffic, account and behavioral data into reliable decisions about what is human, what is automated, and what is abusive. You'll work hand-in-hand with our signals-focused bot-detection engineer, from raw telemetry all the way to production detection and enforcement.

What you'll do

  • Build and run detection pipelines on large-scale traffic and activity data (requests, sessions, accounts, repo interactions, API usage)
  • Develop and deploy detection models and heuristics: anomaly detection, clustering of coordinated activity, graph-based approaches, supervised classifiers where labels exist
  • Define features from client and network signals together with the signals engineer, and measure how robust they are as attackers adapt
  • Build the feedback loops: labeling, evaluation, false-positive monitoring, dashboards, alerting
  • Investigate live campaigns end-to-end (fake account waves, metric inflation, large-scale scraping) and turn what you learn into durable detections
  • Keep things proportionate and privacy-respecting, and minimize impact on legitimate users and automated-but-legitimate workloads (CI, research crawlers, integrations)

Requirements

  • You have strong experience applying data science or ML to adversarial problems in production: bot detection, fraud, abuse, spam, security analytics or similar
  • You're fluent in Python and SQL, and comfortable with large-scale data tooling (Spark, ClickHouse, BigQuery, or similar)
  • You've taken models or detection logic from exploration to production and kept them working over time
  • You understand web traffic and network data well enough to reason about what a signal really means and how it can be spoofed
  • You think in terms of precision/recall trade-offs, attacker adaptation and operational cost, not just offline metrics
  • You're pragmatic, autonomous, and you enjoy working closely with one or two people in a fast-moving team

Nice to have

  • Published work on bot detection, web measurement or adversarial ML (a PhD is welcome but not required, as long as you want your work running in prod)
  • Experience with graph analytics or streaming detection
  • Familiarity with the ML/open-source ecosystem and the Hugging Face Hub

One more thing

At Hugging Face we believe great AI shouldn't require a massive cluster, we build for everyone, especially the GPU-poor. And because we read every application, here's a small sign that you read this one too: start your answer to the first application question with the words “GPU-poor and proud 🤗”. No trick, no catch, it just tells us a real person is on the other side.

Benefits

More about Hugging Face

We are actively working to build a culture that values diversity, equity, and inclusivity. We are intentionally building a workplace where people feel respected and supported—regardless of who you are or where you come from. We believe this is foundational to building a great company and community. Hugging Face is an equal opportunity employer and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We value development. You will work with some of the smartest people in our industry. We are an organization that has a bias for impact and is always challenging ourselves to continuously grow. We provide all employees with reimbursement for relevant conferences, training, and education.

We care about your well-being. We offer flexible working hours and remote options. We offer health, dental, and vision benefits for employees and their dependents. We also offer parental leave and flexible paid time off.

We support our employees wherever they are. While we have office spaces in NYC and Paris, we're very distributed and all remote employees have the opportunity to visit our offices. If needed, we'll also outfit your workstation to ensure you succeed.

We want our teammates to be shareholders. All employees have company equity as part of their compensation package. If we succeed in becoming a category-defining platform in machine learning and artificial intelligence, everyone enjoys the upside.

We support the community. We believe major scientific advancements are the result of collaboration across the field. Join a community supporting the ML/AI community.

jobs.description:
About VictoriaMetrics

We are the company behind the popular open-source, high-performance time-series database and monitoring solution: VictoriaMetrics. We’ve now also known for our open source logs management solution, VictoriaLogs, as well as the new VictoriaTraces.. Fortune 500 companies use our products as their core monitoring & observability solutions. Our services are used by Adidas, WIX, Grammarly, CERN and thousands others. Our open source products have been downloaded 1B+ times to date.

About the Opportunity

Our revenue organization (Sales, Customer Success, Business Development, Partnerships, and Solutions Engineering) has grown fast, and the systems behind it have grown organically: several HubSpot pipelines, a set of prospecting, intent, and call-intelligence tools, and a lot of operational knowledge that still lives in people's heads and spreadsheets.

We are hiring our first Revenue Operations Lead to turn this into one operating system for revenue: clean data, automated workflows, dashboards leadership actually uses, a forecast we can trust, and an operating cadence the whole team runs on. You will report to the VP of Sales and work with every revenue team, plus Marketing and Finance.

This is a builder role. You will be hands-on in HubSpot and in the data every week, and you will be the person who decides what we stop doing manually.

Our Values

At VictoriaMetrics, we believe that high impact is not a function of talent alone, but of how talent is applied. Our formula:

Impact = Ownership × Quality × Creativity × Speed × Integrity

Ownership -You act like a founder of the revenue engine — not a passenger. You own your pipeline, your accounts, and your results.

Quality -You build durable customer relationships, not fragile wins. High standards in every proposal, conversation, and follow-up.

Creativity -You find non-obvious paths to revenue. You adapt the playbook, or invent a new one, when the situation demands it.

Speed -You test, learn, and iterate quickly. You move with urgency but not at the cost of accuracy or trust.

Integrity -You do the right thing even when it costs you. You build trust with customers and colleagues — and you keep it.

We are looking for someone who embodies these values, not as a checklist, but as a way of working. The Revenue Operations Lead will be the person who turns these values into systems: ownership of the data, quality of the process, and integrity of every number we report.

What You Will Do
HubSpot & GTM Systems

  • Be the system owner for HubSpot across our Sales, Customer Success, and Partnerships pipelines: data model, properties, lifecycle stages, deal stages, permissions, and integrations.

  • Own the wider GTM stack (call intelligence, prospecting and enrichment, website intent, email and calendar integrations): integrations, adoption, licenses, renewals, and cost.

  • Set and enforce data governance: field definitions, required properties, deduplication, enrichment, and recurring hygiene audits.

  • Bring product and open-source usage signals (Cloud sign-ups, downloads, community activity) into the CRM so teams can act on them.

Process Automation & AI

  • Design and automate lead routing and hand-offs (BD to AE, partner-sourced to Partnerships, Sales to Customer Success) with clear SLAs and tracking.

  • Automate the repetitive work: task creation, renewal triggers, follow-ups, approvals, and CRM updates from calls and emails.

  • Use AI tools and agents to remove manual effort, from call summaries flowing into HubSpot to account research and data clean-up.

  • Document every core process as a simple, current SOP that a new hire can follow on day one.

BI, Reporting & Forecasting

  • Build the dashboards leadership runs the business on: pipeline coverage, conversion by stage and source, win rates, cycle time, ARR, NRR and GRR, and BD-, partner-, and conference-sourced pipeline.

  • Build and run the forecasting model and the weekly forecast cadence with the VP of Sales and team leads.

  • Define the source-attribution model with Marketing, BD, and Partnerships, so every opportunity has one clear origin.

  • Turn data into decisions: surface risks, trends, and bottlenecks before they show up in the quarter-end number.

Revenue Planning & Deal Desk

  • Own the operational side of annual planning: capacity, quota, territory, and hiring models, built with the VP of Sales and Finance.

  • Run the deal desk: quote and discount approval paths, order forms, non-standard terms intake, and the hand-off to Legal and Finance.

  • Administer commission plans: monthly calculations, plan documentation, and a clear process for questions and disputes.

Sales Enablement

  • Build the onboarding and ramp program for new revenue hires: ramp plans, checklists, and product and process certification.

  • Own the enablement content hub (decks, battle cards, case studies, pricing, playbooks) and keep it current.

  • Train teams on tools and processes and hold them to it; adoption is part of the job.

  • Measure enablement: ramp time, time to first meeting, and process adoption.

Revenue Org Orchestration

  • Run the operating cadence: inputs for weekly syncs, pipeline reviews, QBRs, and planning cycles.

  • Partner with Customer Success on renewal operations and a customer health score.

  • Own the RevOps roadmap and request intake, and prioritize transparently across teams.

  • Be the connective tissue between Sales, Customer Success, BD, Partnerships, Solutions Engineering, Marketing, and Finance.

About You
Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, ideally as a first or founding RevOps hire.

  • Architect-level HubSpot administration (Sales Hub, Service Hub, Operations Hub): workflows, custom objects, properties, reporting. HubSpot certifications are a plus.

  • Strong data skills: SQL, spreadsheet modeling, and at least one BI tool (Looker Studio, Metabase, Tableau, Power BI, or similar).

  • Hands-on with automation platforms (Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar), APIs, and webhooks; you use AI tools every day.

  • You have built forecasting, lead routing, deal desk, or commission processes before and can show the before-and-after.

  • Fluent in metrics: ARR, NRR, GRR, pipeline coverage, win rate, sales cycle.

  • Excellent written English; you document processes so others can actually follow them.

  • Experience with developer tools, open-source, infrastructure, or data platforms is a meaningful advantage.

Mindset & What Sets You Apart

  • Automation-first: if you have done something twice, you are already building the workflow.

  • Data skeptic: you question numbers that look wrong and can explain the ones that look right.

  • Service with a backbone: you help every team, and you say no when a request would break the system.

  • Builder mentality: you are energized by creating structure from scratch.

  • Radical transparency: you share what is working and what is not, early and clearly.

  • Technically curious: you want to understand how our product is used, not just how it is sold.

Together We Will

  • Build a revenue operating system that lets a lean team perform like a much larger one.

  • Give leadership a forecast and a set of numbers they trust without a second spreadsheet.

  • Replace manual work with automation and AI, so our people spend their time with customers.

  • Support your personal and professional growth with real ownership, competitive compensation, bonuses, flexible hours, and a remote-first culture that trusts you to deliver.

Please note: this position is designed for Independent Contractors with their own registered business entity

About the Role

Marketing is our pure customer acquisition engine. Meta Ads brings in new players. SEO brings in new players. Everything else is support.

We're hiring a Performance Marketing Manager whose entire job is to hit monthly customer acquisition targets through two channels: paid acquisition and SEO. You own the targets. You own the channel mix. You own the budget decisions. You own the stack.

You are a performance marketer at heart — you live in dashboards, obsess over CAC and ROAS, and get excited by optimization. But you also have taste. You can tell when a piece of content will land or flop, you brief creatives in a way that inspires them, and you intuitively see cultural moments (Ramadan, Dubai 30x30, National Day, derbies) as acquisition opportunities before anyone points them out.

You are also a stack thinker. You don't just execute what you inherit — you continuously assess whether the setup is optimal. You weigh in-house vs freelance vs agency vs automated with sharp judgment, back it up with cost and performance data, and bring clear recommendations to the CEO.

What You’ll Own

  • Monthly customer acquisition targets — new users, CAC, channel mix. Set collaboratively with the CEO at the start of each month. You are personally accountable for hitting them.
  • Meta Ads — plan, launch, optimize and scale campaigns across Facebook and Instagram. Own creative briefs, audience targeting, budget allocation, daily performance management, A/B testing, attribution.
  • SEO growth + strategy — manage our SEO workstream end-to-end. Set keyword priorities, review on-page and off-page work, challenge recommendations, own the SEO roadmap and outcomes.
  • Content strategy + partner management — set monthly content priorities with the CEO at the start of each month. Translate into a brief for our content partner by day 5. Review the proposed calendar at mid-month, push back where it misses the brief, approve.
  • Marketing stack optimization — continuously assess whether each marketing function is best handled in-house, by a freelancer, by an agency, or automated. Make recommendations to the CEO on stack composition. Own vendor selection and transitions.
  • KPI reporting — a weekly dashboard the CEO reads in 5 minutes. Spend, reach, conversion, CAC per channel, progress against monthly targets, trend vs. last week. Monthly deep-dive with a clear point of view on what to change next month.
  • Proactive improvement — every weekly review, you bring 2-3 recommendations backed by data. Not "here's what happened" — "here's what happened AND here's what we should do about it."

Monthly Targets & Accountability

This role is target-driven, not activity-driven. The CEO sets monthly targets with you on the 1st of each month covering:

  • New user acquisition (total)
  • CAC (ceiling)
  • Channel split: paid vs organic contribution
  • Monthly spend discipline (variance vs budget)

Hitting these targets is the measure of success. Weekly check-ins are for course-correction, not reporting theatre.

Requirements

Must-Haves

  • 3-5 years hands-on performance marketing in a consumer brand, startup, or agency
  • Deep Meta Ads experience — personally run and optimized campaigns at meaningful spend levels (USD 10K+/month), not just briefed someone else

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer — Semiconductor & Vacuum Hardware
jobs.description:
Role Title: Mechanical Design Engineer — Semiconductor & Vacuum Hardware

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Fully remote

Opportunity Snapshot

Pay: $90 -$155/hour

Duration: Initial phase of 20 part packages; production phase to follow

Location: Fully remote, no geographic restrictions

You'll need: 5+ years designing CNC-machined production parts, technical decision authority, and access to parametric CAD software

Your tasks: Author original CAD part packages, and peer review packages from other engineers

micro1 is engaging senior mechanical design engineers to create original CAD part packages for a client project in semiconductor and vacuum hardware. Your engineering judgment is what matters here — no prior AI experience required.

Each package is a new part you design from scratch: a difficult, high-value CNC part with a specific machining challenge, backed by a drawing with full GD&T, a design rationale, and a production scenario you justify from experience. Every part is independently reviewed by three other engineers, and you'll review others' work as well.

What you'll do

  1. Design original parts in parametric CAD, delivered as native files plus STEP.
  2. Produce the technical drawing: dimensions, tolerances, GD&T and datums, material and condition, finish, revision, drawing standard.
  3. Write the design context: intended function, interfaces, operating conditions, the machining challenge, and your material and process rationale.
  4. Build the production scenario: estimated unit cost and drivers, CNC cycle and setup hours, assumed volume, sourcing difficulty and lead time — with the engineering basis for each estimate.
  5. Peer review other engineers' packages against technical quality, production realism, and engineering value, with part-specific evidence for every score.
  6. Revise your own packages against review findings.

What we're looking for

  1. 5+ years of production engineering experience with comparable CNC parts, materials and processes in semiconductor or vacuum hardware.
  2. Technical decision authority: you owned or approved critical design choices — drawing, tolerance or material approval, production release, or enforcing engineering quality standards. Design leads, principal and staff engineers, and technical authorities are the profile.
  3. Experience at OEMs or specialist suppliers whose engineering standards you can reproduce.
  4. Strong GD&T and tolerancing judgment, including cost and inspection implications.
  5. Access to parametric CAD software (SolidWorks, NX, CATIA, Creo or similar) and the ability to deliver native files plus STEP.
  6. Industry experience, not academic.

Important: originality and IP

Every design must be your own original work. You cannot use designs owned by a current or former employer or customer, and you cannot substitute public or purchased CAD. All deliverables become the client's property. If you're currently employed, check your employment agreement regarding outside work and invention assignment before applying.

How the selection process works

  1. Apply and complete the screening questions
  2. Complete the AI interview for this role — it's how your expertise gets in front of the client
  3. Profile review, including evidence of comparable parts and decisions owned
  4. Onboarding — our Talent Ops team will get you set up

Sales Development Representative, EMEA
100% Remote | Full-time Contractor | Focus: European Markets

Schedule: European business hours, Monday through Friday, roughly 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM CET.

Location: Open to candidates based in EMEA, or anywhere outside the US where you can reliably cover European business hours. This is an international contractor role and is not open to US-based candidates.

About Gymdesk
Gymdesk is modern gym management software built for gym owners who want to run and grow their business. We serve thousands of martial arts academies, boutique fitness studios, and multi-location gyms worldwide with CRM, billing, scheduling, payments, and member management in one platform.
We already get steady inbound interest from across Europe, and the region is dense with martial arts academies and boutique gyms. This role exists to go get that market on purpose instead of waiting for it to find us. And we are looking for the right person to be part of that from day one.

About the Role
We are hiring our first Sales Development Representative (SDR) focused on the European markets. You will prospect, contact, and qualify gym owners across the region, then book meetings for our Account Executive team.
This is a phone-forward role, but it is not a pure cold dialing seat. Gym owners in Europe are wary of unknown international numbers, so you will run a sequenced approach: a warm-up email or message first, then the call, then persistent and polite follow-up. You will often reach a front desk staff member before you reach the owner, and getting past that conversation with credibility is a core skill in this job. You are measured on qualified pipeline, not activity for its own sake, and we will make sure you have what you need to succeed.

What You'll Own

  • Run outbound sequences into European gyms, including martial arts academies, boutique studios, and multi-location operators. Expect 60 to 100 outbound touches per day across calls, email, and SMS.

  • Lead with a warm-up touch before dialing.

  • Handle the front desk conversation well and get to the person who makes software decisions.

  • Work cold prospect lists of gyms running competitor software.

  • Work expired and inactive trial lists that need a human to re-engage them.

  • Follow up fast on inbound leads and demo requests. Speed to lead is a core expectation.

  • Run qualification conversations that uncover how the gym operates today.

  • Book qualified prospects onto an Account Executive's calendar and write a handoff note the AE can actually use.

  • Log every call, outcome, and qualification detail in HubSpot the same day. Clean data is part of the job, not an afterthought.

  • Follow GDPR and local outreach rules in every market you work.

  • Hit and exceed monthly targets for qualified leads (SQLs) and AE-accepted qualified leads (A-SQLs).

Who You Are

  • 2+ years in an outbound sales development, telesales, or high-volume cold calling role, ideally selling B2B software or services into European markets, the US, or the UK.

  • Excellent spoken English with a clear, easy-to-understand accent. This is a phone-first role.

  • Comfortable with rejection and high volume. Connect rates in European markets can run lower than in the US, so persistence matters more than average here.

  • Genuinely curious in conversation. You ask questions and listen instead of reading a script at people.

  • Able to think on your feet.

  • Organized and CRM-disciplined. You update records without being asked.

  • Coachable. You want call reviews, you act on feedback, and you improve week over week.

  • Self-directed. Your manager and the AE team sit in a different time zone for most of your shift, but you are never on your own. Support is always a Slack message away.

  • Reliable home setup: quiet workspace, stable high-speed internet, a backup power or internet plan, and a quality headset.

  • Bonus: experience selling into European markets, conversational fluency in another European language (such as German, French, Spanish, Italian, or Dutch), experience selling to small business owners, experience in fitness or martial arts, or familiarity with HubSpot and cloud dialers such as Aircall.

Tools You'll Use

jobs.title: Core Support Expert - French (x5)
jobs.description:
Company Overview Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM). What you'll do The Core Expert ensures exceptional customer support by troubleshooting issues, resolving inquiries, and managing account, billing, and subscription queries. Proficiency in multiple languages is required; this role demands effective communication and problem-solving skills and significantly enhances customer satisfaction and organizational success by providing support to customers in their preferred language. The Core Support Expert is a pivotal role within Docusign's customer service delivery, serving as a strategic advisor to customers and their primary point of contact. Our commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences is exemplified by the Core Customer Support Expert, who embodies technical proficiency, customer-centricity, and a collaborative approach. With a focus on educating, troubleshooting, and delighting customers, this role bridges the gap between customers and various internal functions within Docusign. Whether it's resolving technical inquiries, addressing billing issues, or providing general support, the Core Support Expert ensures that customers receive timely and effective assistance. Furthermore, the Core Support Expert serves as a conduit for customer feedback, advocating for their needs and preferences within the organization. By working closely with cross-functional teams, they expedite issue resolution, enhance support practices, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. In essence, the Core Support Expert plays a vital role in empowering customers to maximize the value and adoption of Docusign's software, driving customer satisfaction and loyalty. This Support Expert will also act as a communications bridge for our customers, using their preferred language while advocating for relevant and appropriate cultural references to deliver a world-class customer experience. Support Experts should be fully professionally proficient in the language they support, and at least an advanced independent user of English if that is not the primary language to support. A language assessment provided by an independent third party might be required to objectively identify the actual oral and writing language proficiency of the selected candidate. This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Vendor Manager. Responsibility Deliver proactive and reactive support for customers, partners, and Docusign internal teams to resolve issues, address subscription inquiries, and provide exceptional support for Docusign products and associated services Handle incoming support channels to troubleshoot customers' inquiries and issues with Docusign products, including account access, setup, document workflows, billing, etc Utilize support tools and resources necessary to solve customer queries, including telephone, chat, Salesforce, Jira, and Docusign proprietary systems Identify product improvements, bugs, and opportunities to enhance the customer experience proactively Promote Docusign products and services to customers and prospective customers via consultative discussion and evaluation of their service and support needs Meet and exceed Docusign Customer Support service level goals Manage communication between Docusign and customers, ensuring timely updates and effective resolution of issues Serve as an advocate for customer needs and feedback within the organization, working to improve overall customer experience and satisfaction Provide support for internal peers on product knowledge and engagement paths including translation to and from English to the customer's language Contribute to reviewing and translating localized language content as needed. Manage communication between Docusign and the customers using their preferred local language Job Designation Remote: Employee is not required to be in or near an office frequently and works from a designated remote work location for the majority of the time. Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law. What you bring Basic 3+ years of related experience Fluent in French and English High School Diploma Experience in a customer-facing role (e.g., hospitality, customer service, etc.) Experience in a customer-facing role specifically in customer support Experience solving customer service issues both technical and account-related Preferred Multilingual in other Docusign supported languages (French, Portuguese, Japanese, German, Spanish, or Italian) Familiarity or experience with the Docusign product range Professional experience within relevant industries for which Docusign provides solutions General understanding of internet technologies Understanding or experience working with Windows and/or Apple operating systems Familiarity with Jira and Salesforce for case management Bachelor's degree or higher in a relevant field Understanding of modern markup and programming languages such as XML, JavaScript/jQuery, or similar Knowledge of troubleshooting in a web-based environment including HTTP, JSON, IIS, HTML, and CSS Understanding of log analysis using network tools such as Fiddler, HAR Analyzer, browser developer tools or similar Customer service and/or specific language market/region knowledge and experience Superior oral and written communication skills Self-motivated, goal-oriented, highly collaborative, creative, excellent organizational and time management skills Effective communication skills, a key component of this role, with audiences that include customers and peers Ability to maintain composure in critical situations and communicate clearly with both internal and external customers Life at Docusign Working here Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal. We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live. Accommodation Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at . If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at for assistance. AI in Our Hiring Process At Docusign, we embrace technology to enhance efficiency and create a better candidate experience. We may record or transcribe interviews using enterprise AI tools to assist with meeting notes and interview documentation so our teams can stay fully engaged in the conversation. All hiring decisions remain 100% human-led. You have the right to opt out at any time by notifying your recruiter or interview team, with zero impact on your candidacy. We encourage using AI tools to research and prepare beforehand. However, to ensure an authentic evaluation, live AI assistance or external recording bots during interviews are not permitted. jobs.title: Creator Partnerships Specialist (YouTube)
jobs.description:
Company: EcomSEO (ecomseo.co), a growth and SEO agency for DTC e-commerce brands

Location: 100% remote, Latin America (Argentina preferred). Must overlap 5+ hours with Amsterdam time (CET).

Type: Full-time contractor, paid monthly in USD

Pay: USD 2,500 to 4,000/month

About the role

You will run YouTube creator partnerships for Tobio’s (tobioskits.com), a beginner-friendly watercolour kit brand selling to the US, UK, Canada and Australia. You own the full pipeline: find creators, score them, reach out, negotiate, onboard, ship kits, review drafts, track results, and turn winners into long-term ambassadors.

What you will do

  • Find 5k to 100k sub YouTube creators in art, craft and watercolor

  • - Score each creator and set a max fee from their median views

  • - Reach out to 200 creators in week 1, then 100+ per week (email + Instagram and YouTube DMs)

  • - Negotiate flat fees (USD 100 to 500 per video) plus affiliate commission and discount codes

  • - Set up Shopify discount codes, seeding orders and video briefs

  • - Track views, orders, revenue and ROAS for every video and send a short weekly report

  • - Turn top creators into repeat partners and retainers

What you bring

  • Fluent spoken and written English (C1 or higher). You talk to US creators every day.

  • - 2+ years in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, UGC or talent management

  • - Experience with US or EU DTC or e-commerce brands

  • - You have negotiated paid creator deals and affiliate or commission structures

  • - You think in numbers: CPA, ROAS, revenue per creator

  • - Comfortable with Google Sheets, Gmail, Shopify, Discord

  • - Bonus: YouTube experience, art or hobby niche, agency background

How to apply

Apply via this form, including a short Loom video: . Also answer these 3 questions in English:

  1. Describe the best creator deal you negotiated: creator size, fee, commission, result.

  2. 2. How would you price a sponsored video for a YouTuber with 25k subs and 8k median views?

  3. 3. Share a link to a creator campaign you ran, or describe one in 3 sentences.

jobs.title: Principal Statistical SAS Programmer - Multi Sponsor
jobs.description:
As a Principal Statistical Programmer in our multi sponsor business unit, you are central to the successful delivery of complex projects for renowned, innovative and global pharmaceutical and biotech companies.


This position allows you to participate in the development of innovative new benchmark drugs for a wide variety of therapeutic areas.


You can be 100% home-based in EMEA or you can work from our local office in your home country.


Summary of Responsibilities:

  • Perform the role of the Lead Statistical Programmer.
  • Plan, execute and oversee all programming activities on a study, including but not limited to, resource estimation, working within budget, meeting timelines, maximizing quality, interaction with other departments and the client, etc.
  • Develop and maintain SAS programs to create complete SDTM and ADaM datasets and TFLs, and perform QC of SDTM, ADaMs and TFLs.
  • Produce Define XML/PDFs, Analysis Results Metadata (ARM), aCRFs and Reviewers Guides to support SDTMs and ADaMs.
  • Develop and/or lead the development of complex specifications for SDTMs and ADaM datasets and contribute to the development of Fortrea and Client standards.
  • Review SAPs and TFL shells from a programming perspective for studies and advise on the development of complex TFL shells from a programming perspective.
  • Mentor less-experience programmers in the processes around SDTMs, ADaMs and TFLs ensuring adherence to department practices and processes.
  • Present and share knowledge at department meetings.
  • Respond to QA and client audits and support qualification audits.
  • Contribute to proposal activities and participate in bid defenses meetings in order to win new business.
  • Continually identify and suggest ways to improve the efficiency, quality and productivity of statistical programming.
  • And all other duties as needed or assigned.

Qualifications (Minimum Required):

  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in mathematics, statistics, computing, life science, health science, or related subjects.
  • Experience and/or education plus relevant work experience, equating to a Bachelor's degree.
  • Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements.
  • Fluency in English – both verbal and written – is a must

Experience (Minimum Required):

  • Typically, 6 years of SAS® programming experience in the CRO or Pharmaceutical industry, or an equivalent combination of education and experience to successfully perform the key responsibilities of the job.
  • Experience as lead statistical programmer on complex studies in clinical research.
  • Knowledge in all aspects of clinical trials from initial study set-up to study completion with an excellent understanding of the roles and responsibilities of all related disciplines, e.g., Biostatistics and Clinical Data Management.
  • Broad knowledge of all CDISC requirements related to SDTM and ADaM, including define.xml, Reviewer's Guide and submission standards.

Learn more about our EEO & Accommodations request here.

jobs.title: Client Success Manager / Director (EMEA/UK)
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an analytical, hands-on client success leader to own our client relationships and lead implementations from kickoff through go-live and beyond. You’ll be the trusted partner for institutional clients, lead complex onboarding projects, and drive retention and growth across your accounts. You’ll also help build how client success works at KOR. If you have deep experience in OTC derivatives or regulatory reporting, like being close to the detail as well as the relationship, and use modern tools (including AI) to scale what you do, this role is for you. We’ll hire at Manager or Director level depending on experience.

About us

We are a VC backed fintech with a live product in the regulatory trade reporting space and growing list of institutional clients. Our product journey has started in the US with expanded services covering Canada, UK, EU, Australia and Singapore. If you want to join a scale-up that is going to provide growth and ownership, keep reading.

KOR is a company built on leading edge cloud technology built by industry domain experts and world class in-house engineering. We're on a mission to innovate B2B trade servicing starting with regulatory reporting in time for a global wave of mandated changes hitting all segments of market participants across OTC derivatives transactions. We’re solving the most challenging problems around by bringing fresh designs and solutions to data utility, quality, and processing inefficiencies... while unlocking insane value for clients.

Teamwork and laser focus are central to everything we do at KOR. With the right support, we believe small independent teams with deep expertises achieve better results and encourage skilled people to take responsibility and grow their careers. We live by the mantra of work humble, work smart, and work together.

What you’ll do

  • Own a portfolio of institutional client relationships across EMEA/UK, from operations teams up to senior stakeholders

  • Lead client implementations end to end: scoping, planning, coordinating with our engineering team, test cycles and go-live

  • Be the senior escalation point, working through complex reporting, data and regulatory issues with clients

  • Drive retention, renewals and account growth, and partner with sales on expansion and new client pre-sales

  • Define and improve client success processes: onboarding playbooks, health scoring, QBRs and escalation paths

  • Use AI and automation to scale the team’s work and lift the client experience

  • Bring client and regulatory insight back into product priorities and KOR working groups

  • Visit clients on-site for kickoffs, go-lives, executive meetings and relationship reviews

  • Director level: lead and grow the EMEA/UK client success team, including coaching analysts, and own CS metrics and reporting to leadership

Requirements

About you

You’re analytical, client-facing and hands-on. You like to understand how things work, you’re comfortable going deep into data, and you take ownership of outcomes. You see AI and modern tooling as a way to do better work faster, not a novelty.

  • 6+ years in OTC derivatives or regulatory reporting, with significant client-facing or implementation experience (Director: 10+ years, including leading people or a function)

  • Strong working knowledge of EMEA/UK regimes (EMIR, REMIT, MIFID), with exposure to CFTC, SEC, CSA, ASIC or MAS as a plus

  • Proven track record leading complex implementations for institutional clients

  • Experience owning client relationships, renewals and account growth

  • Analytical and comfortable with data: able to diagnose an issue yourself before escalating

  • Already using AI tools in your daily work and keen to shape how a team uses them

  • Excellent communicator, from technical teams to executives

  • Based in EMEA/UK region and happy to travel to clients regularly (around 10–20%)

  • Nice to have: SQL, APIs/JSON, ISO 20022 or FpML, experience at a reporting vendor or trade repository, experience building a CS function at a scale-up

At KOR, company culture and fit to it is everything to us. We are looking for an open-minded, humble, driven, communicative, team-player to join us.

What we have to offer

  • Fully remote

  • A culture of trust, ownership and constructive feedback

  • Competitive salary

  • A modern tool stack, including AI, and room to shape how we use it

  • A span of control that matches your ambitions and skills

  • Tell us what else matters to you

Beyond the package, we’re committed to a working relationship that runs both ways. We’ll listen, take your needs and goals seriously, and invest in your professional growth. If you want room to grow at a company that values your work and backs your ambitions, we’d like to hear from you.

Highlights

Own EMEA/UK client relationships, lead implementations and drive growth. Analytical, hands-on, AI-savvy. Fully remote in EMEA/UK region with regular client travel.

With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA's mission is to design safe and sustainable transport solutions to bring people together, develop social inclusion and facilitate access to employment, education and leisure throughout the world.

For 65 years, the Group has been working alongside cities and regions to contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their infrastructure and transport systems, throughout the life cycle of their projects. SYSTRA is involved from the earliest stages of design through to the testing, deployment and maintenance phases. jobs.title: Senior Sales Development Representative (EMEA)
jobs.description:
your mission

About the role


AI didn't kill the SDR role. It killed the average one. The ones who survive — and win — are the ones who figured out how to use AI as a force multiplier rather than a shortcut.

This is not a high-volume, spray-and-pray prospecting role. Timefold sells a technical platform into companies where scheduling, routing, and optimization are commercially important. Good outbound therefore starts with understanding the account, identifying the right trigger, and creating a relevant reason for the right person to speak with us.

You will work closely with Account Executives, Marketing, and Solutions Engineering to create qualified conversations in target accounts. You will focus on software vendors, OEMs, and technically mature organisations with complex planning problems.

The SDR owns the work before the opportunity: account research, outreach, early qualification, and a clean handoff to Sales. The Account Executive owns the opportunity and commercial process once it is qualified.

This role reports to the Head of Sales.

What the role looks like

Build qualified outbound demand
  • You dig into target accounts and prioritize them based on ICP fit, relevant use cases, company context, product or open-source adoption signals, and commercial potential — no spray-and-pray here.
  • You catch the signals that actually matter: hiring sprees, funding rounds, product launches, tech stack changes, content engagement, or operational complexity that screams "we need this."
  • You map accounts like a detective, pinpointing the technical, operational, and executive stakeholders who actually move the deal.
  • You run outreach that doesn't feel like outreach — tailored messages across email, phone, LinkedIn, and the communities where our audience actually hangs out.
  • You turn conversations into qualified meetings and Sales-accepted leads that AEs are genuinely excited to pick up.
  • You keep HubSpot squeaky clean — contacts, activity, source, lead status, and qualification data, all accurate, all the time.
  • You share the playbook, openly: what messaging lands, what objections keep popping up, which personas and signals convert, and which account segments are worth chasing.
  • You team up with Marketing, trading campaign feedback, outbound insights, and content ideas that actually make prospects lean in.
  • You help shape Timefold's outbound motion as we scale — this isn't a role where you follow a script, it's one where you help write it.
Craft outreach for technical buyers

We are targeting developers, architects, engineering leaders, product leaders, and data teams — that means you'll touch upon genuinely complex planning and optimization problems, not just the buzzwords around them.

  • You engage operational and executive stakeholders with messaging tied to business outcomes: service quality, operational efficiency, scheduling complexity, growth, and build-versus-buy decisions.
  • You know the difference between a technical evaluator, a champion, an operational stakeholder, and the economic buyer — and you flex your approach accordingly, because one-size-fits-all pitches don't work on people who solve hard problems for a living.
  • You treat open-source and community signals as a research starting point, not a shortcut — you validate relevance before ever mistaking interest for intent.

Convert & engagement

Success is not measured only by emails sent or meetings booked.

  • Meaningful engagement in target accounts — not just opens and clicks, but real conversations.
  • Meetings that actually show up and get accepted by Sales.
  • Sales-qualified leads with credible fit, real intent, and a clear next step — no mystery leads.
  • Opportunities sourced from the right accounts and segments, not just whoever answered the phone.
  • Sharp insight on which messages, personas, and triggers actually convert — so the whole team gets smarter, not just you.

your profile

You're probably a fit if

  • Start-up energy doesn't scare you - it motivates you.
  • 3+ years of SDR, BDR, or outbound sales experience in a B2B technology company.
  • A track record of creating qualified pipeline or Sales-accepted opportunities not only booking meetings.
  • Experience prospecting into mid-market or enterprise accounts.
  • Experience engaging technical buyers such as developers, architects, engineering leaders, product leaders, or IT teams.
  • You've used AI outreach tools hands-on and have strong opinions about what actually works
  • You think in workflows, not tasks — you automate the repetitive so you can focus on the creative
  • You've prospected into technical buyers and know that developers delete lazy sequences on sight
  • You measure yourself on pipeline generated, not activity logged
  • Curiosity about technology. You do not need to be an engineer, but you should be able to hold a credible conversation about technical platforms, developer tools, and enterprise software.
  • Data-driven and rigorous with HubSpot and CRM hygiene.

why us?

This is Timefold -We’re building the future of intelligent planning—join us on the journey.


We are an AI planning optimization platform built on powerful, field-proven open-source solver technology. Simply put: we enable software builders to tackle some of the world's most complex, high-impact operational planning problems. From optimizing vehicle routing and employee scheduling to streamlining maintenance planning and field service logistics, our tech delivers massive economic value where it matters most.

We are on a relentless mission to free the world from wasteful scheduling! Founded in 2023, we represent the exciting next chapter of OptaPlanner—the legendary, field-proven open-source project that laid the foundation for everything we build today.

Today, we are a technically sharp, deeply passionate team of over 40 people. While our headquarters are nestled in the iconic Wintercircus building in Ghent, Belgium, we operate as a remote-first team with vibrant hubs across Belgium, the Czech Republic, Brazil and the US.

We're hiring a Senior Sales Development Representativeto help build Timefold’s outbound motion in the EMEA region.

What You'll Learn

Joining Timefold provides a unique opportunity for continuous learning and growth. In this role you will learn:

  • How to build an outbound motion from zero inside a technical product company — the kind of experience most SDRs never get because they inherit someone else's playbook
  • How enterprise developers and engineering leaders actually buy software — and why that changes everything about how you sell
  • How to use AI as a genuine commercial advantage, not just a tool to send more emails
  • What it takes to convert open-source community traction into enterprise pipeline — a motion that is becoming one of the most valuable in B2B GTM

What do we offer


Culture & Environment

At Timefold, we offer more than just a paycheck; we offer a culture where you can thrive. We promise an open and authentic workplace where you will be trusted to act, trusted to ask, and supported as you seek to grow. In return, we look for people who are ready to own and deliver impactful results.

Standard Perks

  • A Full Time position in a fast growing start up environment
  • A competitive salary package complemented by a range of local benefits

How we work & connect

  • Flexibility : our focus is on your talents, not your location. Choose the working arrangement that suits you best, whether it is remote, hybrid or on-site
  • Our dedication to creating an inclusive environment, where diversity is celebrated and everyone is treated with fairness and respect <3
  • Regular team building activities and gatherings to enhance (international) team spirit and cooperation (this requires a willingness to travel once or twice a year)

jobs.title: Human Resources Director | Head Office
jobs.description:
Hi!

We are Boosta, a holding tech company that creates, develops, and invests in digital businesses with global potential. Today, we collaborate with over 800 specialists from different parts of the world, and millions of users use our products and services.

We are looking for an HRD: a systems builder who can turn HR into a structured, measurable function, with services adapted to the maturity of each Business Unit, so that Boosta and its BUs can scale and achieve business goals through people. Someone who thinks strategically and delivers practically.

What you will do:

  • Operationalize and scale the People operating model (structure, roles, service model, processes and governance) so it works effectively across the holding as it grows.
  • Ensure efficient, high-quality People service delivery that meets evolving business needs.
  • Make People measurable: run and develop a metrics framework and dashboard that enable data-driven decisions.
  • Run talent management: attract and retain top talent; reduce dependency on critical people and knowledge keepers through succession planning and knowledge continuity; develop managers and leaders.
  • Partner with leaders across the holding to identify and address business-critical People challenges and drive strategic initiatives aligned with business priorities.
  • Own People risk management, ensuring alignment with the company’s overall risk management framework.
  • Ensure the desired culture and Code of Conduct are embedded in key People processes and consistently reinforced.
  • Own HR systems: ensure alignment with business needs and company standards, effectiveness, adoption and continuous improvement.
  • Lead and develop the People team: build a strong, stable team with clear goals aligned to business objectives.

What we expect from you:

  • 10+ years in HR, including 5+ years as Head of People / HRD / CPO / CHRO in rapid-scaling, high-performance environments.
  • Experience building or rebuilding the People function in a multi-business structure (holding, group of companies, tech group) with businesses at different maturity levels.
  • Experience implementing and scaling HR operating models.
  • Strong people analytics & data-driven decision frameworks.
  • Strong people leadership skills: able to develop experienced professionals, delegate effectively, and build autonomous, accountable teams.
  • Strong Change management skills.
  • Practical experience using automation and AI to improve HR processes and efficiency.
  • Proven ability to partner with senior business leaders, challenge perspectives constructively, and influence strategic decisions.
  • Strong business acumen: links People decisions to business results and cost.
  • English proficiency: Upper-Intermediate or higher, both spoken and written.

Nice to have:

  • Experience leading large-scale organizational change.
  • Strong negotiation and conflict management skills.
  • Experience in service-based companies (outsourcing / outstaffing / professional services).
  • Experience building Employee Experience as a measurable system.
  • Operations background.

Personal qualities:

  • Strategic thinker with a strong execution drive: keeps the helicopter view while ensuring results without micromanagement.
  • Strong ownership and accountability: takes responsibility for outcomes, acts proactively, and delivers on commitments.
  • Critical and solution-oriented thinker: challenges assumptions, identifies root causes, and focuses on practical solutions and measurable impact.
  • Strong prioritization skills: focuses on what matters most, sets boundaries, and aligns stakeholders around priorities.
  • Resilient and comfortable working in complex, fast-changing environments.
  • Strong communicator and cross-functional leader: communicates clearly and persuasively, able to align stakeholders, influence experienced professionals, and drive results without relying on formal authority.
  • Business-oriented and service-minded: understands business needs, creates value for internal customers.
  • Data-driven: makes decisions based on facts and analysis.
  • High standards and growth mindset: strives for excellence, welcomes feedback, and continuously improves.

Your journey with us:

  • Step 1: Pre-screen with Recruiter.
  • Step 2: Interview with Hiring Manager.
  • Step 3: Competency Interview.
  • Step 4: Peer Interview.
  • Step 5: Final Interview.
  • Step 6: Reference check and Job Offer.

What we offer:

  • 28 business days of paid off.
  • Flexible hours and the possibility to work remotely.
  • Medical insurance and mental health care.
  • Compensation for courses, trainings.
  • English classes and speaking clubs.
  • Internal library, educational events.
  • Outstanding corporate parties, teambuildings.
