jobs.title: Client Success Analyst / Senior Analyst (EMEA / UK)
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an analytical, hands-on Client Success Analyst to work directly with our institutional clients on implementations, data questions and day-to-day support. You’ll dig into trade data, test and validate client setups, find the root cause of reporting issues, and make sure clients get full value from KOR. If you have a background in OTC derivatives or regulatory reporting, love solving problems with data, and like using modern tools (including AI) to work smarter, this role is for you. We’ll hire at Analyst or Senior Analyst level depending on experience.

About us

We are a VC backed fintech with a live product in the regulatory trade reporting space and growing list of institutional clients. Our product journey has started in the US with expanded services covering Canada, UK, EU, Australia and Singapore. If you want to join a scale-up that is going to provide growth and ownership, keep reading.

KOR is a company built on leading edge cloud technology built by industry domain experts and world class in-house engineering. We're on a mission to innovate B2B trade servicing starting with regulatory reporting in time for a global wave of mandated changes hitting all segments of market participants across OTC derivatives transactions. We’re solving the most challenging problems around by bringing fresh designs and solutions to data utility, quality, and processing inefficiencies... while unlocking insane value for clients.

Teamwork and laser focus are central to everything we do at KOR. With the right support, we believe small independent teams with deep expertises achieve better results and encourage skilled people to take responsibility and grow their careers. We live by the mantra of work humble, work smart, and work together.

What you’ll do

  • Support client implementations end to end: onboarding, data mapping, test cycles and go-live readiness

  • Analyze client submissions, rejections and reconciliation breaks, find the root cause and work with clients and engineering on the fix

  • Respond to client questions on data, product and reporting rules, and own tickets through to resolution

  • Triage incoming issues and escalate with a clear analysis attached

  • Build and maintain client documentation, runbooks and FAQs

  • Use AI and automation to speed up analysis, triage and reporting, and suggest improvements to how we work

  • Track client health and adoption signals and flag risks or opportunities early

  • Join client meetings and occasional on-site visits for kickoffs and go-lives

Requirements

About you

You’re analytical, curious and hands-on. You like to understand how things work, you’re comfortable going deep into data, and you follow an issue through until it’s solved. You see AI and modern tooling as a way to do better work faster.

  • 2–5 years in OTC derivatives, regulatory reporting, trade operations or a client-facing data role (Senior Analyst: 4+ years)

  • Familiarity with at least one reporting regime (e.g. CFTC, CSA, EMIR, ASIC, MAS)

  • Strong analytical skills: comfortable with large data sets and Excel, and good at tracing an issue to its root cause

  • Already using AI tools in your daily work and looking for ways to automate

  • Clear, structured communicator with clients and internal teams

  • Organized and reliable, able to juggle several client issues at once

  • Based in EMEA/UK and happy to travel to clients occasionally (around 5–10%)

  • Nice to have: SQL, APIs/JSON, ISO 20022 or FpML, Jira

At KOR, company culture and fit to it is everything to us. We are looking for an open-minded, humble, driven, communicative, team-player to join us.

What we have to offer

  • Fully remote within EMEA/UK

  • A culture of trust, ownership and constructive feedback

  • Competitive salary

  • A modern tool stack, including AI, and room to shape how we use it

  • A span of control that matches your ambitions and skills

  • Tell us what else matters to you

Beyond the package, we’re committed to a working relationship that runs both ways. We’ll listen, take your needs and goals seriously, and invest in your professional growth.

If you want room to grow at a company that values your work and backs your ambitions, we’d like to hear from you.

Highlights

Work hands-on with institutional clients on implementations, data and issue resolution. Analytical, AI-savvy, fully remote in EMEA/UK with occasional travel.

jobs.description:
About Cogstate

At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

About the Clinician Network

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.

Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

All applicants to the Clinician Network are kept in our active pipeline, and you’ll also receive our monthly Clinician Network newsletter, which shares updates and upcoming openings.

About the Role

Cogstate Clinicians are clinical psychologists or neuropsychologists responsible for delivering remote clinical interviews and cognitive assessment batteries to subjects with preclinical dementia, enrolled in a pharmaceutical clinical trial.

Cogstate provides all consultants with comprehensive, fully compensated training on general Cogstate operational policies, study-specific procedures, customized clinical interviewing skills and virtual cognitive assessment prior to performing remote scale administrations. Regular supervision and ongoing recalibration of clinical skill set will be provided.

*These are contract position.

*They are fully remote.

*Hired employee will work on an as needed basis based on their schedule.

- VINELAND/VABS Administration Experience Required
- Arabic Fluency Required

Key Responsibilities

Central Rating

  • Remotely administering semi-structured clinical interview assessments and cognitive battery of tests to study subjects and caregivers.
  • Remotely delivering computerized and traditional cognitive assessments via a tele-health platform.
  • Scoring completed scale administrations.
  • Participating in regular clinical skill recalibration activities.

Central Monitoring

  • Providing reviews of completed neuropsychological test batteries for central monitoring of data to ensure accuracy in administration and scoring and contribute to the overall success of a clinical trial.
  • Reviewing response forms and recordings of remote scale administrations and offering feedback to raters via email and telephone communications.

Qualifications & Expertise

  • MA/MS in Psychology or equivalent
  • ≥25 administrations of study scales or similar semi-structured clinical interviews
  • Experience working with pediatric populations with neurodevelopmental delays
    • Rare disease experience is a plus, including Angelman syndrome, Phelan-McDermid syndrome, Fragile X syndrome, or similar disorders
  • Vineland/VABS administration experience
  • Formal training in clinical interviewing and cognitive assessment, including experience working with pediatric populations and caregivers
  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience with direct clinical interviewing and psychological assessment in clinical research industry, academic or clinical settings
  • Direct experience with cognitive/behavioral/functional assessment of neurological/psychiatric populations
  • Ability to meet deadlines, being highly organized and methodical, with attention to detail to ensure delivery
  • Proficiency with MS Office, including Word and Excel, email, teleconference platforms such as Skype, Zoom or other similar applications, and cloud-based storage service.
  • Arabic Fluency

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

jobs.title: Security Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Canonical is looking for exceptional security-focused software engineers to be integrated across product teams. While they also contribute to the product as engineers, their primary focus is to challenge the entire team to think more deeply about security through state-of-the-art practices such as threat modeling, table-top exercises, architecture and design reviews, static analysis tools, and fuzzing, among others. 

These roles encompass all aspects of product security, including feature development, vulnerability response, proactive security, and open source community participation. Engineers in these roles collaborate closely with other Canonical teams, customers, and partners across the open source ecosystem.

Each product engineering team at Canonical reserves one or two openings for security-oriented software engineers. We also develop a number of products driven entirely by security needs, such as our AppArmor kernel investments and the Ubuntu Security Guide (USG). As the publisher of Ubuntu, we also handle long-term security response for the entire operating system and open source ecosystem. Working with tens of thousands of upstreams means that we need to be fluent in every major programming language and design, build, and adopt sophisticated tools that enable us to work at scale and speed with confidence.

Apply here if you are an exceptional security-focused software engineer, passionate about open source, and excited by Canonical's products and mission.

This role requires the ability to be productive in a globally distributed team through strong self-discipline and motivation. It also involves mandatory international travel at least twice a year, typically for one week.

Location: Worldwide, this is a globally remote role

What you'll do

Security roles might tackle any of the following:

  • Define, implement, and document new security features 
  • Lead security-focused initiatives within a product engineering team
  • Analyze, fix, and test vulnerabilities in open source software
  • Contribute to Ubuntu and upstream open source projects to benefit the community 
  • Audit and analyze source code for vulnerabilities 
  • Integrate new tools into our security infrastructure, pipelines, and processes
  • Achieve and retain various security certifications 
  • Extend and enhance Linux cryptographic components to meet country-specific compliance requirements, such as FIPS and Common Criteria (CC) certifications
  • Work with external partners to develop Center for Internet Security (CIS) benchmarks
  • Design and develop hardening automation for Ubuntu 
  • Stay up to date with trends and developments in the security industry
  • Develop, test, and maintain new software capabilities
  • Provide guidance and support to other engineering teams on security best practices

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • A track record of going above and beyond expectations
  • Thorough understanding of the common categories of security vulnerabilities and how to fix them
  • Knowledge of modern software engineering techniques
  • Familiarity with open source development tools and methodologies 
  • Skill in one or more of C, C++, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Ruby, PHP, or JavaScript/Typescript
  • Experience as a security champion
  • Experience driving security within a wider SSDLC process 
  • Professional written and spoken English 
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred) 
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability 
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation 
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills 
  • Results-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments 

Optional skills we also value

  • Clear and effective communication with both the team and Ubuntu community members
  • Experience working with the Linux kernel 
  • Experience with security certifications and knowledge of FIPS and/or Common Criteria (CC)
  • Experience with OVAL (Open Vulnerability Assessment Language) 
  • Knowledge of cryptographic modules such as OpenSSL and Libgcrypt
  • Knowledge of low-level Linux cryptography APIs
  • Demonstrated ability to learn quickly
  • Performance engineering experience 

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

jobs.description:
The role of an Engineering Manager at Canonical

As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, you must be technically strong, but your main responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You will develop and review code as a leader, while at the same time staying aware of that the best way to improve the product is to ensure that the whole team is focused, productive and unblocked.

You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do meaningful work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. You will also be expected to be a positive influence on culture, facilitate technical delivery, and regularly reflect with your team on strategy and execution.

You will collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers, product managers, and architects, producing an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals.

We expect Engineering Managers to be fluent in the programming language, architecture, and components that their team uses, in this case popular open-source machine learning tools like Kubeflow, MLFlow, and Feast.

Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. The commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation is as important, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high-performing team.

Location: This is a Globally remote role.

 

What your day will look like

  • Manage a distributed team of engineers and its MLOps/Analytics portfolio
  • Organize and lead the team’s processes in order to help it achieve its objectives
  • Conduct one-on-one meetings with team members
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Interact with a vibrant community
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Attend conferences to represent Canonical and its MLOps solutions
  • Mentor and grow your direct reports, helping them achieve their professional goals
  • Work from home with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events 

What we are looking for in you

  • A proven track record of professional experience of software delivery
  • Professional python development experience, preferably with a track record in open source
  • A proven understanding of the machine learning space, its challenges and opportunities to improve
  • Experience designing and implementing MLOps solutions
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Additional skills that you might also bring

The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.

  • Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions for the cloud.
  • Experience with building machine learning models
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Experience in the Linux and open-source software world
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing
  • Passionate about software quality and testing
  • Experience working on a distributed team on an open source project -- even if that is community open source contributions.
  • Demonstrated track record of Open Source contributions

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

 

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

jobs.title: Junior Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu
jobs.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Every year we select new junior professionals into the Canonical Kernel Team, to work on the Linux kernel for Ubuntu. If you’ve enjoyed operating systems in your coursework or current role, you are confident in your ability to write high quality C and possibly Rust, and are ready to take the plunge and see how it all works, then this would be a great place to pursue your next career stage. We are a global team working to ship the world's most widely used Linux kernel, across the very latest silicon and cloud, where you can apply and grow your software engineering skills.

The Canonical Kernel Team builds and maintains all supported Ubuntu Linux kernels for a variety of platforms and architectures from small embedded devices to standard desktop/server systems to large-scale cloud environments. In your first year you will tackle serious initiatives, which include but are not limited to:

  • Optimized solutions for key Silicon and Cloud partner platforms
  • Developer platforms such as Raspberry Pi and RISC-V
  • Enabling Ubuntu on a wide range of embedded systems
  • Security hardening and exploit mitigation
  • Third-party driver integration and distribution, such as graphics
  • Expanded driver support for bleeding-edge PC platforms

We select candidates that are recent university graduates or early career professionals who are enthusiastic to develop kernel-level software in multiple areas including security updates, patching, and testing. The successful candidate will have a background in software engineering, be motivated to work in a distributed team and willing and able to travel globally twice a year for company engineering events.

These are full-time positions available to prospective or recently graduated students.

Location: We have home-based Kernel Teams in every timezone.

The role entails

  • Collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Learn from senior mentors to demystify the inner workings of the Linux kernel and how it is distributed
  • Work closely with external silicon, cloud, or hardware manufacturer delivery teams on bleeding-edge platforms
  • Diagnose and resolve issues in the kernel reported by customers, the community, and discovered by your own rigorous testing
  • Take personal responsibility for the delivery of various flavors of the Ubuntu Linux kernel
  • Improve tooling and automation for delivery and test of Ubuntu Linux kernels
  • Submit, review, and apply kernel patches, working with both internal and external upstream maintainers

What we are looking for in you

  • Well-organized and motivated self-starter able to thrive in a remote work environment
  • Professional manner with colleagues, business partners, and the open-source community
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and verbal
  • Programming experience in C and/or Rust
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git
  • Understanding of operating system kernel fundamentals
  • Ability to travel twice a year for company events of up to two weeks length

Nice-to-have skills

  • Interest and experience in Rust
  • Python and Bash scripting ability
  • Prior experience with Ubuntu/Debian/Snap packaging
  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP’s, and other low level system engineering

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. jobs.title: Senior UX Designer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Spectro Cloud helps platform teams and cloud providers modernize and manage infrastructure for the AI era without adding more tools or operational complexity.
With PaletteAI, enterprises, public sector organizations, neoclouds and sovereign clouds can build, govern and operate full-stack environments across VMs, Kubernetes, edge, regulated and air-gapped locations, and AI infrastructure. PaletteAI Launchpads help teams start quickly with urgent outcomes such as VMware migration, token cost control or edge modernization, then scale into enterprise-wide lifecycle management, governance and fleet operations on the same platform.

About The Team

The UX team sits within Product and designs across the Spectro Cloud portfolio: PaletteAI, Edge and the PaletteAI Launchpads. We are a small, senior UX team, so each designer owns problems end to end, from discovery with product managers and customers, through flows and prototypes, to reviewing what ships. We also own the Spectro Cloud design system. Alongside product work, we are rebuilding how UX itself works in the AI era: shared personas and product knowledge that AI agents can use, agent-assisted research and evaluation, and design inputs structured so that AI-generated code comes out consistent and usable. This role joins to help lead that shift while doing hands-on product design.

What You’ll Do

  • Design complex systems end to end. Own UX for major product areas such as multi-cluster and VM lifecycle management, AI infrastructure and edge workflows. Map how objects, permissions and states relate across the platform before designing screens, so flows hold together across products.
  • Build AI-native UX workflows. Design, test and document how the team usesAI tools and agents for research synthesis, prototyping, design QA and evaluating flows. Turn what works into repeatable processes, templates and knowledge bases the whole team uses.
  • Close the gap between design and code. Prototype in code with AI coding tools, structure design inputs (tokens, component references, constraints, copy guidelines) so engineers and coding agents produce consistent UI, and review implemented work against design intent.
  • Evolve the design system. Contribute components, patterns, tokens and documentation, and help keep Figma and the code library in sync.
  • Partner across Product and Engineering. Work with product managers, engineers, documentation and customer-facing teams to frame problems, make trade-offs explicit and validate decisions with users.
  • Raise the bar on craft and process. Run design reviews, share techniques andhelp shape how the UX team operates as it grows.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product or UX design experience, including at least 3 years on complex B2B, enterprise or technical products (for example cloud, infrastructure, developer tools or data platforms).
  • A portfolio showing systems-level work: information architecture, multi-step workflows and object models, not only individual screens.
  • Hands-on experience contributing to or maintaining a design system(components, tokens, patterns and documentation).
  • Regular use of AI tools in your own design work (for example AI coding assistants, agents or AI prototyping tools), with concrete examples of how they changed your process or output.
  • Knowledge of front-end code (HTML, CSS and JavaScript or React)
  • Experience running or contributing to user research and usability testing, and turning findings into design decisions.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma.
  • Professional working proficiency in English and experience collaborating with distributed teams across time zones.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing for Kubernetes, virtualization, cloud infrastructure,DevOps or AI/ML platforms.
  • Experience building agentic or AI-assisted workflows, such as custom GPTs or agents, MCP integrations, structured prompts or automated evaluation.
  • Experience connecting design and code, such as design tokens, Storybook, Figma Code Connect or contributing to a front-end codebase through Git.
  • Experience shaping team processes or operating models, such as design review rituals, intake processes or UX quality metrics.
  • Background in systems thinking, service design or designing for administrators and operators.

jobs.title: Delivery Engineer, ML, EMEA
jobs.description:
About Hilbert

Hilbert is a scalable, data science-first growth engine that gives B2C teams predictive clarity into user behavior, revenue drivers, and the actions that drive sustainable growth. Fully agentic by design, Hilbert shrinks months-long decision cycles to minutes.

From Fortune 10 enterprises to beloved brands like FreshDirect, Blank Street, and Levain Bakery, operators run their growth on Hilbert. We're also co-building alongside leading AI companies.

The Mission: Turn Ground Truth Into Growth
Hilbert has two parts: a data foundation that gives our AI agents a high-fidelity view of each business, and an agentic web app where growth teams find and act on insights. The scores and audiences you build feed both: our agents reason with them, and our activation sends them into paid media and CRM.

The hard problem

Every customer's data is different, their compute may be ClickHouse, Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery, and their teams want proof, not promises. Your models have to work in that environment and show measured uplift. We want every pod to stay lean and efficient across very different customer environments, delivering quality work at startup speed. You focus on delivery; our sales engineers handle pre-sales. Your work centers on customers in your own region: supporting customers elsewhere is a rare exception, and your global work is mainly staying aligned with Hilbert colleagues in other regions.

What you'll do

  • Feature stores: build customer-specific, point-in-time correct features on the data foundation.
  • Models: train, tune and validate propensity, churn, lifetime value, uplift and custom models, starting from our ML templates and building custom models when a customer needs something the templates don't cover. New model types that many customers will need are built first by our product engineering team, and you roll them out to later customers.
  • Model analysis: go beyond aggregate metrics to verify what each model has learned, what drives its scores, and how it behaves across segments and on edge cases.
  • Deployment: models run in the customer's own environment or on our managed stack. In either case, understand the constraints, pin down the requirements, design the ML system to fit, and write the scores and audiences our agents and activation use.
  • Measurement: own the statistical design inside our growth team's measurement plan, from power and holdout setup to uplift analysis.
  • Trust: document models for the customer's data science and risk teams, then monitor and retrain them in production.
  • Productization: turn repeated features and model patterns into product with our product engineering team.

What success looks like

  • Audiences built from your models lift the agreed growth metric, such as conversion or retention, against a holdout group, and that result decides whether the customer takes them to production.

Who you are

  • The translator: you explain a model to a customer's data science team and earn their trust.
  • The experimenter: you'd rather prove uplift in a holdout test than show off an offline metric.
  • The pilot: you get the most out of AI agents across model iterations, from feature ideas and experiment runs to error analysis, and help build them into how the team works.
  • The systems thinker: you build reusable features, pipelines and automation instead of one-off models, so a small team can deliver across very different environments.
  • Extensive applied ML experience on tabular customer data, with strong Python and ML libraries.
  • Extensive hands-on deep learning experience, from designing architectures and loss functions to training and shipping models in production, with PyTorch or a similar framework.
  • Feature engineering in SQL warehouses such as Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery.
  • Working data engineering experience: building and debugging pipelines, data orchestration, data modeling and data quality checks, enough to own your feature pipelines end to end with our data engineers.
  • Production ML with tools such as MLflow, Weights & Biases or Vertex AI.
  • Solid experiment design and uplift measurement.
  • Comfortable working in a distributed team across time zones.

Nice to have

  • DevOps, software architecture and security knowledge
  • Growth-focused data projects experience
  • Industry experience such as e-commerce, retail, fintech, telco and media
  • Model governance in regulated industries such as banking and telco: model documentation, explainability and PII handling
  • Able to travel to the US when necessary

Reporting and location

You report to your pod's Lead Delivery Engineer and work alongside our data delivery engineers and product engineering team. The role is based in EMEA. Delivery runs remotely, with occasional visits to our largest customers.

Why join us

At Hilbert, we move fast, work collaboratively, and give people real ownership over their impact. As a fast-growing company, there's no shortage of room to grow — you'll take on new challenges quickly and shape the path as you go.

Hilbert is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive culture, and we welcome applicants of all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

jobs.description:
About BloomPath

AI that works for the people who keep the real world running.

BloomPath builds AI for frontline teams operating in complex, high-compliance environments. We help teams spend less time on paperwork and more time doing the work that matters. Our products fit into systems customers already use, such as Kintone, rather than forcing them to change how they operate.

We build for production. Security, reliability, compliance, and clear data boundaries are part of the product from day one.

About the Role

We’re hiring a software engineer with 1–4 years of experience to help build and scale BloomPath’s platform.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you will build core product features, solve practical technical problems, and grow alongside a high-performing team. You will take ownership of features from implementation through production with support from senior engineering leadership.

We value curiosity, craftsmanship, and clear communication over rigid hierarchy. You will report directly to the CTO and collaborate closely with engineering, product, leadership, and customers to ship reliable software.

What You’ll Do

  • Build, test, and maintain production software across our platform

  • Work across TypeScript, Python, APIs, data pipelines, integrations, and AI-powered capabilities

  • Own features and technical tasks from implementation through deployment and ongoing operation

  • Participate in design and code reviews, collaborating with teammates to ship simple, reliable solutions

  • Contribute to engineering practices across automated testing, observability, security, and delivery

  • Build AI workflows that are grounded, observable, evaluable, and reliable in real customer environments

  • Take ownership of your work and learn quickly in a fast-paced environment

Our Technology

Our stack includes:

  • TypeScript and Node.js

  • Python

  • Google Cloud Platform

  • Docker and Kubernetes

  • PostgreSQL

  • APIs, integrations, and multi-tenant services

  • Gemini and other large language models

  • LangChain, Langfuse, and Phoenix

  • GitHub and modern CI/CD practices

You do not need experience with every tool. Strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly matter most.

What We’re Looking For

Must-Have

  • 1–4 years of professional software engineering experience (or equivalent practical experience building production software)

  • Solid proficiency in Python, TypeScript, or a comparable language

  • Experience building and shipping web applications, backend services, or APIs

  • Working knowledge of relational databases (such as PostgreSQL) and RESTful APIs

  • Familiarity with Git, modern CI/CD workflows, and cloud-based environments

  • High ownership, strong problem-solving skills, and willingness to ask good questions when navigating ambiguity

  • A collaborative mindset and openness to giving and receiving constructive code review feedback

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or Google Cloud Platform

  • Familiarity with LLMs, AI evaluation, tracing, or observability tools

  • Experience working in regulated or high-compliance environments

  • Experience in an early-stage startup or small, fast-moving engineering team

What Makes This Role Different

  • You will ship real production features quickly and see their direct impact on frontline teams

  • You will work directly with the CTO, founders, product leaders, and customers—gaining high-velocity mentorship and exposure to the whole business

  • You will solve practical operational problems rather than hypothetical AI use cases

  • You will grow your skills across full-stack engineering, cloud infrastructure, and applied AI in a supportive environment

Why BloomPath

Most AI products require teams to change how they work. We don’t. We build and tune a platform that fits into real workflows and existing systems for teams that need reliability, not experiments. You will help build production-grade AI while growing your engineering career at a fast-moving company.

jobs.title: SAP MM Functional Consultant
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced SAP S/4HANA MM/Sourcing & Procurement Functional Consultant with strong hands-on experience in Materials Management, Sourcing & Procurement, Inventory Management, and end-to-end purchasing processes.

The candidate will be responsible for understanding business requirements, designing and configuring SAP S/4HANA solutions, implementing procurement processes, and providing functional support across implementation, rollout, and support engagements.

  1. End-to-End Implementation: Participate in the complete SAP S/4HANA MM implementation lifecycle, including requirement gathering, fit-gap analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, cutover, go-live, and post-implementation support.
  2. Sourcing & Procurement: Configure and support end-to-end procurement processes, including PR, RFQ, quotation management, PO, contracts, scheduling agreements, source determination, and purchasing approvals.
  3. Purchasing Configuration: Configure purchasing document types, number ranges, purchasing organizations, purchasing groups, account assignment categories, item categories, release strategies, Flexible Workflow, and pricing procedures.
  4. Source Determination: Configure and support source lists, quota arrangements, purchasing info records, outline agreements, and supplier selection processes.
  5. Inventory Management: Configure and support goods receipt, goods issue, stock transfers, transfer postings, physical inventory, stock adjustments, and special stock processes.
  6. Special Procurement: Support Subcontracting, Consignment, Pipeline Procurement, Third-Party Procurement, Stock Transport Orders (STO), and intercompany/intracompany procurement processes.
  7. Invoice Verification: Configure and support Logistics Invoice Verification (LIV), including invoice posting, credit memos, GR/IR reconciliation, invoice blocks, and discrepancy resolution.
  8. Master Data Management: Manage and support Material Master, Business Partner/Supplier Master, Purchasing Info Records, Source Lists, and other procurement-related master data.
  9. Pricing & Account Determination: Configure purchasing pricing procedures, condition types, access sequences, schema determination, automatic account determination, and valuation settings.
  10. S/4HANA & Integration: Support SAP S/4HANA procurement functionalities, including Business Partner integration, Fiori applications, Flexible Workflow, and integration with FI/CO, SD, PP, QM, WM/EWM, and PS.
  11. Functional Specifications & Testing: Prepare functional specifications for enhancements, reports, interfaces, forms, and workflows. Execute unit and integration testing and support UAT, defect resolution, and validation.
  12. Documentation & Training: Prepare functional and configuration documents, test scripts, user manuals, and provide training to key users and business users.
  13. Application Support: Troubleshoot functional issues, perform root cause analysis, manage incidents within agreed SLAs, and recommend process improvements.
  14. Project & Client Coordination: Coordinate with business stakeholders, onsite/offshore teams, ABAP developers, and technical consultants. Support implementation, rollout, upgrade, and pre-sales activities as required.
  1. Experience: Minimum 4-6 years of hands-on SAP MM / Sourcing & Procurement experience, including implementation and support exposure. Experience in at least two full-cycle SAP S/4HANA implementations is preferred.
  2. Education: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  3. SAP S/4HANA Expertise: Strong hands-on experience in SAP S/4HANA MM configuration, implementation, and support.
  4. S/4HANA Functional Knowledge: Understanding of SAP Fiori applications, Business Partner integration, and Flexible Workflow.
  5. Project Methodology: Experience with SAP Activate, functional testing, UAT, cutover, go-live, and post-implementation support.
  6. Technical Knowledge: Understanding of SAP Solution Manager or equivalent tools, basic ABAP debugging, and functional troubleshooting is an advantage.
  7. Communication & Analytical Skills: Strong problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with clients, business users, and technical teams.
  8. Travel Flexibility: Willingness to travel to client locations based on project requirements.

Nice to Have:

  • SAP S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement certification.
  • Experience with SAP Ariba integration (Sourcing, Buying and Invoicing, or Business Network) is an advantage.
  • Exposure to Central Procurement and procurement automation.
  • Experience in SAP implementation, rollout, and AMS engagements.

Inflexion, a key player in SAP solutions since 2008, is dedicated to expediting business transformation through AI-powered solutions. As a SAP Gold Partner, Grow with SAP Partner, SAP Cloud ALM Partner, and holder of the PCOE certification, we pride ourselves on delivering superior services, recognized by numerous awards from SAP, including the recent Best Delivery Award. Our team of certified consultants specializes in various SAP solutions including ERP, CRM, HCM, SM, BTP, and SCM. We cater to businesses of all sizes across diverse industries, enhancing productivity and growth through innovative processes and technology. We offer flexible engagement models and competitive pricing, ensuring client satisfaction with every release.

jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.


We are seeking a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to join our dynamic team specializing in a technology marketplace platform for engineering talent and delivering cutting-edge Generative AI (GenAI) managed solutions for enterprise clients.

In this strategic role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying scalable machine learning algorithms and systems. Your proven experimental mindset and extensive practical experience will be key in optimizing our platform’s performance, improving our GenAI offerings, and driving measurable impact across diverse business use cases.

Exceptional Leadership:

You don’t need to be a people manager to be a leader, and you’ll serve as a role model for the rest of the company. Think about the feedback your peers typically give you – if it usually sounds like the below, we want to hear from you.

  • Low ego, low drama, servant leader: You share credit, take blame. You like being wrong because it means someone else had an even better idea.
  • One team mentality: You break silos across teams. You put the company and mission first above yourself and team alone.
  • Great listener, hungry for feedback:You’re always seeking to improve – our product, our business, yourself. You solicit diverse opinions and deeply listen.
  • Owner, not renter:You see a problem, you fix it or find someone who will. The buck stops with you.
  • Player-coach:You roll up your sleeves and get scrappy. You do this by proactively collaborating with your team while actively engaging in important details.
  • Business problem solver: You’re not just a functional expert; you consistently get praise for approaching your function through the lens of solving business problems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain robust and scalable machine learning models and pipelines tailored to enhance our marketplace platform and GenAI managed solutions.
  • Lead experimentation processes, rigorously validating models through A/B testing, statistical analyses, and iterative improvements.
  • Collaborate closely with data scientists, software engineers, product managers, and client teams to define requirements, build solutions, and deliver impactful, high-quality products.
  • Continuously improve existing ML solutions, ensuring they are performant, efficient, and aligned with evolving business objectives.
  • Ensure adherence to best practices in code quality, data integrity, and infrastructure reliability, with a strong emphasis on scalability and maintainability.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute actively to team growth, knowledge sharing, and fostering an experimental, innovation-driven engineering culture.
  • Stay current with advancements in machine learning, AI methodologies, and marketplace technologies to propose innovative solutions proactively.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field.


Requirements

  • ****10 Years of experience required****
  • Proven experience implementing machine learning algorithms and solutions at scale in production environments.
  • Demonstrated experimental mindset, adept at hypothesis testing, experimentation design, and rigorous validation techniques.
  • Expert proficiency in Python and experience with frameworks and libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, and related ML technologies.
  • Extensive experience building and deploying scalable ML pipelines and working within cloud infrastructure environments such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Strong understanding of data structures, algorithm design, and performance optimization techniques.
  • Exceptional problem-solving abilities, coupled with excellent collaboration and communication skills.
  • Track record of technical leadership, mentorship, and successful cross-functional collaboration in agile, dynamic environments.

Benefits

  • Fully Remote work culture - we hire globally and all of our roles are fully remote!
  • Bring your own device stipend - buy your own laptop with funds from us
  • Flexible working hours
  • Equity (as a part of the compensation package)
  • Healthcare, 401k / pension
  • Generous Paid Time Off, Parental Leave, Compassionate Leave

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing

Open Role: Senior Product Marketing Manager

Location: EMEA - Remote

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators.They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

At Canonical, the product marketing team is not just marketing products, we’re building the best Go-To-Market (GTM) engine in the open source world. Our mission is to take the power of open source innovation and bring it to businesses everywhere, from the data center to the edge. We’re growing fast and looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager (PMM) to join our team—someone who loves technology, thrives in fast-paced environments, and wants to make a global impact.

This is a hands-on, multi-disciplinary, and dynamic position, requiring close collaboration with the Product, engineering, content, Sales, and other Marketing teams. The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, technology marketing, and the use of technology in marketing. They prefer to work in an environment that emphasises ownership of GTM campaigns, collaboration, learning, curiosity, and a drive to always improve oneself / the team / the organisation. They love solving problems, getting hands-on, experimenting, measuring, and using automation to make daily life easier.

Why You’ll Love This Role

  • You’ll own the GTM strategy for key products, shaping messaging and positioning that speaks to developers and enterprise buyers alike.
  • You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with product management, sales, regional marketing, content, and partner marketing teams to bring campaigns to life.
  • You’ll get creative, crafting compelling advertising, launch plans, and campaigns that make our products stand out in a competitive landscape.
  • You’ll measure impact, using data to refine messaging, optimize marketing funnels, and drive customer engagement.
  • You’ll be part of a truly global team, working with colleagues in over 85 countries in a fully remote, high-performance environment.

As a product marketing manager, you will:

  • Develop and execute go-to-market (GTM) strategies for a range of products.
  • Lead messaging and positioning efforts ensuring our products stand out in a competitive market.
  • Lead content planning with product managers —from website copy to whitepapers, blogs, and sales enablement materials.
  • Collaborate on marketing campaigns, partnering with regional marketing teams to execute integrated campaigns that drive pipeline growth.
  • Launch new products and features, leading cross-functional teams to drive awareness and adoption.
  • Run competitive analysis, staying ahead of market trends and evolving our positioning accordingly.
  • Support the customer success team on driving customer engagement and growth, working on strategies to upsell and cross-sell across our customer base.
  • Plan and execute global events, live webinars, and community meetups that align with our GTM priorities.

What we are looking for in you

  • A passion for technology and open source—you get excited about innovation, software, and community-driven development.
  • Strong storytelling skills—you know how to craft messaging that resonates with both technical and business audiences.
  • Growth mindset—someone who thrives on experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Data-driven mindset, using insights to refine strategies and improve performance.
  • Experience in product marketing for enterprise software, cloud, DevOps, or open-source solutions.
  • Experience with demand generation, understanding how to translate GTM strategies into pipeline growth.
  • Comfort working cross-functionally with product, sales, partners, and marketing teams.

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.

  • Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

jobs.title: Request for Proposals: Course Design Consultant
jobs.description:
Remote | Consultancy (fixed deliverables) | Individuals or firms; Africa-based applicants strongly preferred

Deadline: 30 December 2026, close of business (Kigali time)

About the assignment

Kepler College, a competency-based university rooted in African knowledge, invites proposals to design two online undergraduate courses:

  • Foundations of African Philosophy: African philosophical traditions, thinkers and debates, applied to ethics, leadership, critical thinking, AI and disinformation.
  • Foundations of African Politics & Economics: Africa's current political and economic dynamics, external interference, and change driven by Africa itself, including intra-African trade and the AfCFTA.

Guiding question: In the age of AI, disinformation and neo-colonialism, what must young Africans know about how to think like Africans, what drives African politics today, and how to build an Africa that trades with itself?

Courses must be online, project-based, video-led and low-bandwidth friendly, and use mainly African scholars and open-access sources. We want an African narrative, not "West vs. China"

Deliverables (per course)

  • Course design document, syllabus and weekly learning plan
  • Scripts for short videos (5–10 min) per module
  • Major applied project, activities and assessments with rubrics
  • Learning materials, facilitator guide and LMS-ready package
  • Revisions based on feedback

Timeline

Contract: 31 Jan 2027 | Syllabi: 6 Mar 2027 | Full drafts: 2 Jul 2027 | Final: 27 Aug 2027

Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in philosophy, political science, economics, African studies or related field (or a firm with such experts)
  • Deep knowledge of African philosophical, political and economic thought
  • Proven experience designing online, project-based, competency-based university courses
  • Assets: Video production, teaching in Africa, knoweldge of East Africa

Proposal requirements

  • Cover letter (individual or firm; one course or both)
  • Technical proposal (max. 5 pages): approach, draft course outline and work plan
  • CV(s), plus firm profile if applicable
  • One or two samples of online course design work
  • Financial proposal in USD, by deliverable and course
  • Two or three references

Evaluation

Approach 30%, expertise 25%, course design 20%, value for money 15%, Africa-based 10%

How to apply

Apply through this page (upload your proposal in the cover letter space) or email: . with the subject "RFP: African Philosophy and Politics & Economics Courses" by 30 December 2026. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

  • 40+ applications in finance, health, wellness, and utility niches
  • 5M+ downloads of our products
  • 3x growth in active users over the past 12 months
  • 50+ core team members and a network of external partners

  • Manage advertising budgets and work towards traffic volume, revenue and profitability targets.

jobs.title: Director of Underground Explorers Program
jobs.description:
About SPUN

SPUN (Society for the Protection of Underground Networks) is a startup NGO with a mission to map and protect the mycorrhizal fungal networks that regulate Earth’s climate and ecosystems. These fungi draw down approximately 13 billion tons of CO2 each year, yet they have been largely overlooked by science, policy, and practice.

Since our founding in 2021, we’ve built a global data platform to make these invisible networks measurable. Through our Underground Explorers program and network of over 700 Science Associates across more than 80 countries, with the majority in the Global South, we generate high-resolution biodiversity maps and ML-powered tools that integrate mycorrhizal data into climate, conservation, restoration, and land management decisions.

Our work spans laboratory research, data science, and robotics through to locally led field applications, and we’ve begun working with policymakers and restoration practitioners to apply our findings on the ground. With strong backing from leading foundations and growing momentum in international policy circles, we’re now at an inflection point: scaling these efforts across more landscapes, institutions, and countries over the long term.

Location: This is a remote position. You can work from Africa, Europe, North America or South America.

The Opportunity

SPUN is seeking a Director for our Underground Explorers Program (UEP) to lead its strategic direction, growth and success. The Underground Explorers Program is SPUN's flagship grant program supporting researchers and local communities to map mycorrhizal fungal networks in their local ecosystems and advocate for their protection. Our aim is to expand our understanding of mycorrhizal fungal diversity globally using a decentralized science approach that is core to our organization.

You will own the vision, quality, and impact of the program: setting funding priorities each cycle, chairing the review and selection process, and ensuring UEP continues to fund scientifically rigorous, Global South focused, locally-led projects. This position will directly supervise the Grants & Operations Coordinator, who manages the program's day-to-day administration, and the UEP Data & Training Scientist on technical and scientific support to grantees. You will also provide program management support for SPUN’s Ground Truth Collective (GTC), a UEP sub-program that works with local researchers to collect high-resolution data across global restoration projects. You will work closely with SPUN’s Data Science Lead who manages the research collaboration with GTC teams, and collaborate closely with the SPUN’s communications team on grantee storytelling. You will work with SPUN’s CFO on budget and disbursement strategy and the Data team for grantee sequencing support.

We are looking for someone that combines scientific credibility in mycorrhizal ecology or a related field with strong program leadership and people management experience, and who is comfortable representing SPUN externally to funders, partners, and the broader scientific community.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Program Leadership

  • Define funding priorities, geographic and thematic focus areas, and targets each grant cycle, using geospatial tools to identify coverage gaps and underrepresented regions or ecosystems.
  • Set and revise selection criteria in line with SPUN’s mission, including geographic underrepresentation, scientific rigor, feasibility, local-PI requirements, and Global South representation.
  • Own the program budget in partnership with the CFO, including grant sizing, travel grants, and program support costs.
  • Represent the UEP externally to funders, partners, and at conferences and symposia, and contribute to funder reporting and proposals.
  • Identify opportunities to evolve the program model, such as new funding tracks, partnerships, or initiatives building on UEP
  • Constantly revise and improve the Program reach, design and operations based on grantee feedback.

Review and Selection Oversight

  • Chair the internal review committee and oversee recruitment and onboarding of external grant reviewers from the scientific community.
  • Lead grantee interviews and bring final funding recommendations to the Executive Director for sign-off.
  • Ensure the review process is rigorous, fair, and consistent with program values across all applicant regions.
  • Decide, with the review committee, which applications are placed on the waiting list and revisited in the following cycle.

Team and Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Directly supervise the Grants & Operations Coordinator: set priorities, provide regular feedback, oversight of general functions and support their professional growth.
  • Serve as the escalation point for grantee issues beyond the Coordinator’s scope, including sensitive program or financial matters.
  • Partner with the UEP Data & Training Scientist to ensure grantees receive appropriate technical support for sequencing, bioinformatic analysis, etc.
  • Work closely with SPUN’s communication team to design innovative approaches to highlight grantee research across media types.
  • Coordinate cross-functionally with Finance/CFO, and legal to keep the program running smoothly.
  • Extend UEP program management to the GTC sub-program in collaboration with the Data Science Lead, including sub-grant disbursements with the CFO, tracking sampling schedules and sample shipments, and managing the GTC budget.

Program Quality and Grantee Experience

  • Design and continuously improve the grantee experience, including answering special requests from grantees.
  • Track grantees access to program benefits and resolve gaps in delivery.

Program Evaluation and Reporting

  • Analyze program-level data — grantee demographics, geographic and ecological coverage, and scientific output — to assess impact and identify priorities for future cycles.
  • Prepare program updates and impact reports for SPUN’s Executive Director, board, and funders.
  • Work with the Coordinator to ensure the Grantee Tracker and reporting systems support high-quality program evaluation.

What we’re looking for

  • PhD or equivalent experience in mycorrhizal ecology, fungal biology, soil science, or a related field.
  • Experience in program design and/or grants management, ideally within a scientific, conservation, or research-funding nonprofit.
  • Demonstrated experience directly supervising staff and managing cross-functional relationships.
  • Track record of designing, launching, or leading a grant, fellowship, or research-funding program end-to-end.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience working with grantees or partners from different countries and cultures, particularly in the Global South.
  • Comfortable representing an organization externally: funders, partners, conferences, and the media.
  • Fluent in English; proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong plus, given UEP’s grantee base across Latin America and Francophone Africa.
  • Strong commitment to equity and inclusion in science.

Bonus, but not required

  • Experience with GoodGrants, Ramp, or Notion.
  • Hands-on experience in mycorrhizal fungal research, soil biodiversity fieldwork, or environmental DNA methods.
  • Existing relationships within the global mycological, soil science, or conservation research community.

Why Join SPUN

We believe in empowering people to do their best work. This is reflected in our benefits that support health, well-being, growth, and balance. They are tailored to local laws so that everyone across our globally distributed team receives the same high standard of support.

What you can expect:

Health Coverage: 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums covered for employees, plus support for dependent coverage.

Time Off: Flexible PTO with a minimum of 25 vacation days per year that we expect you to take, plus local holidays, sick leave, and wellness days.

Volunteer Days: Paid time each year to contribute your skills and energy to causes you care about.

Wellness Support: An annual health stipend, plus a flexible spending account for US-based employees.

Professional Growth: An annual professional development allowance for your learning, skills, and career progression.

Workspace & Tools: A hardware allowance to get you set up, plus monthly work-from-home and annual workspace allowances so you can work well wherever you are.

Exploration & Connection: Opportunities to travel for fieldwork, retreats, and partner collaborations, bringing our team together in person and closer to the ecosystems we work in.

Birthday Celebration: An annual birthday meal stipend, on us.

At SPUN, we embrace diversity as a fundamental pillar of our mission to protect underground ecosystems. Our commitment to decentralized science depends on the diversity of knowledge and experience on our team and among our partners across the globe. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of their race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or background, feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. We highly encourage individuals from traditionally underrepresented or marginalized groups, including but not limited to women, LGBTQIA+ people, individuals from the Global South, and individuals with Indigenous heritage, to apply to join our team at SPUN.

To learn more about our organization and culture, please visit our website .
